target: Attempt an exact infinite counterexample to RowClosing from the periodic legal gap word(3,5,5), rather than using long finite survival as a counterexample.
method: Iterate pairs of exact cyclic temporal profiles. Only a repeated complete pair proves a spatially periodic tail. For each temporal phase compute the four-state inverse transfer map on one cycle and test its third power for constancy.
interpretation: A certified nonsynchronizing cycle could refute the proposed RowClosing hypothesis. A capped orbit is UNKNOWN, never an infinite survivor. A positive extra carrier is not a new prize theorem or grounds for another finite-family PR. No extension of the limits.
